sample_unit: questions (each posed three times in Chinese and English)

links.outcome: ChatGPT response reliability and quality by language (Chinese vs English)
links.effect: Unreliable rate 7.5% for English vs 27.5% for Chinese questions; among reliable answers, English responses were more comprehensive and satisfactory.
links.quote: ChatGPT performed better when responding to questions in English, with an unreliable rate of 7.5% compared to 27.5% for Chinese questions, indicating a more consistent response pattern in English.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's responses to pediatric endocrine questions in Chinese versus English using expert clinician review, without testing an organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
